notes: Summary test build: tap Home +, then Blank project. The recorder should open immediately without a second submit button.

Home + → Summary → Choose projects: compare each project's thumbnail with Home, check a few projects, then Create summary. Their beats should open together as editable copies; the originals stay unchanged.
Try Today, Yesterday and the From/Through calendar dates. The preview should include beats added during those dates, even in older projects.
Create a summary, add a new beat to an older project, then try Since last summary. Only the new beat should be collected.
View last summary should open the previous update. Closing it should return to the summary form with your name and checked projects preserved.
Older beats use their project's last-modified date as an approximation. New beats have precise addition times. Please check thumbnail appearance and the recording flow on your phone.
